purpose: Close observable-catalog coverage for the seven remaining Tian2020 CLASH systems using the complete published CLASH multiple-image table, while keeping its model-selected redshifts, archived LTM likelihood scale, and GR-derived maps out of the metric-neutral response target.

pre_registered_row_policy.measured_position_row: Keep a published sky coordinate only when the arc identifier contains none of c, p, or ?. The paper defines c as candidate, p as a predicted location for a missing counterimage, and ? as additionally ambiguous.
pre_registered_row_policy.independent_spectroscopic_redshift: Treat abs(z.in) as spectroscopic only when the published value is negative, exactly following the table note.
pre_registered_row_policy.independent_photometric_redshift: When no spectroscopic value exists, retain the row-level CLASH catalog zph and its published 95-percent bounds as an independent photometric summary. Do not convert the interval to a Gaussian error.
pre_registered_row_policy.family_summary: A family is independently redshift-anchored only when at least one retained measured image has a spectroscopic z.in flag or a finite zph summary. Preserve row-level values; do not average them after inspecting lens residuals.
pre_registered_row_policy.model_redshift: Retain positive z.in and both LTM/NFW predicted redshifts for audit only; never use them as metric-neutral inputs.
pre_registered_row_policy.position_error: Record the archived Zitrin LTM v2 sigma_pos convention, but label it model-dependent because it is the optimization scale used by a GR lens model rather than a published astrometric measurement covariance.
pre_registered_row_policy.coordinate_covariance: Do not manufacture a metric-neutral covariance matrix. A diagonal matrix based on sigma_pos may be exported only as an explicitly model-dependent control covariance.
pre_registered_row_policy.duplicate_policy: Reject exact duplicate cluster-plus-arc identifiers and duplicate coordinates within a cluster.

metric_neutral_observables: negative-sign spectroscopic z.in values and their references
CLASH catalog photometric-redshift summaries and published 95-percent bounds
model_dependent_audit_products: LTM and PIEMDeNFW predicted source redshifts
archived Zitrin LTM v2 sigma_pos likelihood convention

success_outcome: All seven systems receive a checksum-audited measured-position catalog and at least one independently redshift-anchored family, raising raw observable coverage from 13/20 to 20/20.
failure_policy: Retain exact system-level shortfalls. Do not reinstate ambiguous or predicted images, infer missing source redshifts from a lens model, reinterpret sigma_pos as astrometric covariance, or use GR-derived maps as observables.
